name: calendar-create-event
description: Create a new calendar event. Attendees receive invitation emails automatically. A standing meeting is ONE event with recurrence, never a copy per week.

inputs.title: string
inputs.attendees: object[]? (each { email, name? }. Cannot set RSVP status; use calendar-respond-to-invite for the principal's own RSVP.)
inputs.conferencing: object? (new link: { provider: Google Meet/Microsoft Teams, autocreate: true }. Zoom/other existing link: { provider, details: { url } })
inputs.recurrence: string[]? (one RRULE plus optional EXDATE lines, e.g. ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO"]; start is the first occurrence)
inputs.topic_matches_account: boolean? (true if the topic plainly belongs to that account)
inputs.mailbox: string? (account the event goes out from. With several connected it is required on the principal's calendars and must own calendarId; without it nothing is created and a needs_mailbox error gives per-account evidence for the attendees. Mention the account only when evidence or topic left it in doubt; ask when split.)

outputs.warnings: string[]? (an overlapping hold left in place or not checked)
outputs.mailbox: string? (the account used, when several are connected)
outputs.evidence: string? (agrees | leans_other | none | split for the account used)
outputs.account_note: string? (evidence and topic agreed: don't name the account)
